snippet.title: What If AI Took Your Job Tomorrow? 🤖 24 Hours Left
snippet.description:
Your job ends in 24 hours. An AI just got hired to replace you… and then things get weird. 🤖

Would you rather your job be done by an AI, or by your most annoying coworker? Tell us in the comments 👇

This is an imagined scenario, just for fun.

Whatifaholic answers science, money, tech & AI "what ifs" in under a minute. New Shorts every day.
